scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Asangathit Karmakar Ijjat Monthly Season Ticket Card Yojana
other_conditions: Unorganized workers must be registered with the Chhattisgarh Unorganized Workers State Social Security Board.
Workers who have already received benefits from any other similar state government scheme are not eligible.
benefits_summary: Train pass for daily travel up to a maximum of 150 kilometers.
